title: Helvesec/rmux
claim: Helvesec/rmux — Universal Rust multiplexer with a typed SDK — drive any CLI or TUI app from code. Native on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
why_good: A Rust multiplexer with a typed SDK to drive any CLI/TUI programmatically — the automation primitive agents need to control terminal apps.
value: Sell to agent/automation builders as the reliable terminal-control layer; usage + enterprise support.
risk: Low-level infra with a narrow (if real) audience; agents/frameworks may bundle terminal control natively.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product for automation and integration that can be monetized through a subscription or licensing model.

zh.claim: Helvesec/rmux —— 带类型化 SDK 的通用 Rust 多路复用器:用代码驱动任意 CLI/TUI 应用(Linux/macOS/Windows 原生)。
zh.why_good: 一个带类型化 SDK 的 Rust 多路复用器,能用代码程序化驱动任意 CLI/TUI——agent 控制终端应用需要的自动化原语。
zh.value: 卖给 agent/自动化开发者做可靠的终端控制层:按量 + 企业支持。
zh.risk: 底层基础设施,受众窄(但真实);agent/框架可能原生内置终端控制。
